components.css: .ds-steps { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 50px; min-width: 170px; padding: 6px 10px 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--joint, #CFCCC5); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--face, #FCFCFA); color: var(--ink, #1C1C1A); font: 600 12px 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step:hover { border-color: #B9B6AF; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--verd, #2F6B5E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-no { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6863); } .ds-ties { margin-left: auto; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 6px); gap: 4px; } .ds-ties i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #7A7872; } .ds-ties i.m { background: var(--ink, #1C1C1A); border-color: var(--ink, #1C1C1A); } .ds-step.is-on { background: var(--ink, #1C1C1A); border-color: var(--ink, #1C1C1A); color: #fff; } .ds-step.is-on .ds-no { color: #9FC9BD; } .ds-step.is-on .ds-ties i { border-color: #8E8B84; } .ds-step.is-on .ds-ties i.m { background: #9FC9BD; border-color: #9FC9BD; }

narrative.overview: ShellFlow is cast like the precast panels MFE makes: a quiet concrete ground, smooth panels separated by crisp joint lines, formwork steel for the frame, and a single verdigris accent. The luxury is in restraint and finish, not ornament. People who already know the system find every header, ribbon, step and page exactly where it was; only the material changed.
keyCharacteristics: Concrete ground, smooth panels, 1px joints, 3px corners
Formwork steel header and ribbon; carbon ink for the open page
Verdigris is the only accent: actions, selection and conditions met
Ochre means waiting, iron oxide means critical, and both always come with words
Light, large figures; small, firm labels; tabular numerals everywhere

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Verdigris is the only accent. Every colour the older markup named (sky, indigo, blue, violet) maps to concrete through src/scripts/tailwind.config.js; nothing on a working screen is blue.

rules.name: The State Needs Words Rule
rules.body: Ochre and iron oxide only ever mark state, and always sit next to a label, count or date, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Workbook Colour Exception
rules.body: In the MR11 ledger, each row keeps the MR11 workbook's own font colour (product type) and fill colour (formwork type). They are client data, not decoration, and they are the only colours outside the ramps.

rules.name: The Light Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number above 20px is set light (300). Weight is for labels; size is for figures.

rules.name: The No Card In Card Rule
rules.body: A box inside a slab is a section of that slab: no shadow, no fill, no box border, just a soft joint line above it.

dos: Do map any new Tailwind colour through src/scripts/tailwind.config.js so it lands on the four ramps.
Do use verdigris (#2F6B5E) for the one primary action in a group, for selection and for met conditions.
Do set figures above 20px in light 300 with tabular numerals.
Do start every new page with the shared page heading and give it a page link in PAGE_SLUGS.
Do separate sections inside a slab with a soft joint line (#DDDAD3).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent; blue, indigo and violet are retired.
Don't put a card inside a slab, or a coloured stripe on the side of a card.
Don't use rounded-full on anything that is not a true circle.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons; use lucide icons or drawn SVG.
Don't move the header, ribbon, step order or pages people already know.
Don't recolour MR11 ledger rows; their font and fill colours are workbook data.
